rationale: Roberts is best positioned to write a stare-decisis-sensitive majority that re-centers APA § 706’s command of independent judicial judgment while preserving Skidmore-style persuasive respect to limit disruption. Gorsuch/Thomas are the most likely to write separately to press a more categorical anti-Chevron separation-of-powers rationale, while Kagan is the most likely dissenter to defend Chevron as a permissible background rule and emphasize reliance interests.
